recovery.returned: {{count}} icebound crab pot(s) and their contents are waiting in the fish market's teal recovery chest.
recovery.full: The recovery chest is full. Make some room and we can bring in the remaining gear.
recovery.space: The fish market needs a little clear floor space for its recovery chest.
recovery.letter: The ice has closed some of the old fishing spots.^We brought your stranded crab pots to the teal chest in the fish market. Catches are kept, and unused bait is returned. Bait already used for a catch isn't returned twice.^This is shared harbor storage. Please leave room for the next delivery.^-Ada[#]Your gear is ashore

guide.title: Frosthavn field guide
guide.welcome: Welcome to Frosthavn. K opens your route book and nature notes.
guide.keys: K / Esc: close   1–7 / left-right: pages   up-down: select   R: record nearby clues
guide.tooFar: Stand beside a listed landmark before recording it.
guide.already: This observation is already in your notebook.
guide.loop: Fish from the harbor, sell at the blue fish market, and sleep in the red guesthouse. Repair the shed for smoking and drying. Daily orders pay extra for seasonal fish.
guide.goal.Arrival: Walk west along the town lane and enter the red guesthouse. Claim finished quest rewards in the native journal.
guide.goal.catch: Catch and give Ada three fish in one stack. The first-shipment order has no deadline. Requested fish:
guide.goal.Shed: Give Roan one stack of 40 wood. The harbor counter imports wood (15g each); your farm is cheaper. Repairs finish overnight. The guesthouse writing desk forwards equipment mail.
guide.goal.BoatRepair: Give Roan 2 iron bars in one stack. The supplies counter trades 3 seasonal fish for each bar, twice per save (spring/summer capelin, fall cod, winter polar cod). Imported bars cost 1000g; home-mined bars also work. The boat opens the next morning.
guide.goal.FjordVisit: At the harbor's eastern pier, interact with the route sign to visit the fjord.
guide.goal.DeepCatch: Fishing level 4: use a bamboo pole or better to catch a Greenland halibut at the fjord, then give it to Ada. Training rods cannot catch halibut. Harbor supplies sells a bamboo pole for 500g after the shed repair.
guide.goal.claim: Open the native quest journal to claim a finished reward and continue the shipment chain.
guide.goal.free: Explore, finish daily fish orders, cook, or fill your nature notebook. The fjord route is open.
guide.goal.start: Visit the town and enter the red guesthouse to begin the first-shipment journey.
guide.weather.title: TODAY'S COASTAL CONDITIONS
guide.weather.calm: Calm water. The route runs as planned.
guide.weather.gale: Strong wind and rough water: no outward fjord trip today. The return crossing stays open.
guide.weather.blizzard: Whiteout: no outward boat or dog-team trip today. Marked return paths stay open.
guide.fishing.spring: Harbor: capelin and polar cod. Cast from the wooden piers; keep clear of painted ice.
guide.fishing.summer: Harbor: capelin and Atlantic cod. Summer and autumn char live in the tundra stream.
guide.fishing.fall: Harbor: Atlantic cod. Fjord: golden redfish (level 2+) and halibut (level 4+).
guide.fishing.winter: Harbor: polar cod. Cast west from the upper pier into dark open water. Harbor pots can catch snow crab.
guide.return: Homeward: the shuttle post by the eastern town pier takes you to the airstrip. Press B there for your included return. The fjord boat still returns to the harbor.
guide.service: Harbor supplies: rods, bait, coal, repair materials and recipes. Guesthouse desk: forwarded mail. Shared kitchens: guesthouse and community house.
guide.mapLegend: Orange: you are here. Walking paths and boat route; schematic, not to scale.
guide.directions: North from town to tundra; the northern lookout leads to the mountain trail. North to the glacier, east to camp. The tundra bridge also reaches camp. East from town to harbor; the east post shuttles to the airstrip. The upper yellow house is the community house.
guide.boatOpen: Fjord boat open. Use the route post at the east end of the harbor pier. Return from the landing's west notice.
guide.boatClosed: Fjord boat under repair. Complete Roan's wood and iron requests, then sleep. The tundra trail stays open.
guide.observeHelp: Walk to the landmark, open this book, and press R. Notes use your current location and native date; sleep to save them.
guide.site.rock.name: Rock and town
guide.site.rock.where: Town: beside the guide sign on the central waterfront lane.
guide.site.rock.body: Dark bare rock lies between the houses. Small stairs and the main lane connect the doors to the quay. Snow changes the surface, while the underlying rocky coast remains.
guide.site.harbor.name: A working harbor
guide.site.harbor.where: Harbor: upper pier beside the fishing notice.
guide.site.harbor.body: Ropes, fish racks and wooden berths make this a working waterfront. Safe fishing is from shore and piers; a painting of shore ice is never a walking route.
guide.site.ice.name: Ice from the glacier
guide.site.ice.where: Icefjord: the observation platform beside the deep-water notice.
guide.site.ice.body: An iceberg is a floating piece detached from a glacier. Sea ice forms when seawater freezes. Similar colours do not make them the same kind of ice. Observe both from the marked platform.
guide.site.tundra.name: Low-growing tundra
guide.site.tundra.where: Tundra: the northern wooden lookout at the end of the trail.
guide.site.tundra.body: Tundra vegetation stays low. Short growing seasons and cold favour low shrubs, mosses and lichens over tall trees. Follow the trail through the plants; this is not a snowy forest.
guide.site.camp.name: Shelters for a season
guide.site.camp.where: Field camp: follow the western shelter path south to the notice beside the first dome or tent.
guide.site.camp.body: The camp changes with the season: snow-block domes in winter, canvas tents in the other seasons. At the notice before the western shelter, interact in winter to arrange a small snow-block model. These are demonstration shelters, not every Arctic home. The red research hut offers a bed; the marked trail returns west to the tundra bridge.
guide.changeHelp: The requested fish is out of season. Keep this order if you have stored fish, or change it to three seasonal fish. Reward and next step stay the same. New fish:
guide.changed: Order changed. Give Ada three of the new fish in one stack. No items or money were exchanged.
guide.changeUnavailable: No eligible out-of-season first order. Completed orders and pending rewards stay unchanged.
guide.changeFailed: The order data could not be verified. Your existing order was kept.

flight.boardingOut: Your invitation includes the return. Our transfer takes you to the airport, then north to the snowfield. Bring your curiosity and watch the Arctic light.
flight.boardingHome: Your return is included. You will arrive at the Valley bus stop with your belongings.
flight.hintReturn: B: included return flight | South path: town
flight.phase0: Moonbird Air / Beyond the familiar fields
flight.skip: Esc / controller B: skip and arrive safely
flight.landed: Welcome to Frosthavn. Follow the marked path south to town; K opens your guide.
flight.needInvitation: Look for Yueyueniao's invitation in your mailbox before checking in.
flight.singlePlayer: Air travel currently supports single-player games.
flight.unavailable: The flight is unavailable. You remain here with your belongings.
start.load: Up / Down: choose save  |  Enter: load  |  Esc: back
guide.airWelcome: Welcome to Frosthavn. Follow the marked path south into town; K opens your guide.
guide.goal.airport: Follow the path south past the airport lamps into town. The red guesthouse stands west of the town lane. B at the airstrip checks in for your included return.
guide.goal.noRod: No rod yet? The harbor supplies counter east of town sells a training rod for 25g. At the counter, Tab enables keyboard selection, arrows choose, Enter buys. You can explore first; the shipment has no deadline.
guide.goal.catchProgress: In your pack: {{count}} / 3. Face open water from a pier, hold C to cast, then press C at the bite. The training rod cannot take bait.
guide.goal.deepProgress: Fishing level: {{level}} / 4; suitable rod: {{rod}}; halibut in your pack: {{count}} / 1. This page only reports progress.
weather.boatLocked: The boat is still under repair.
weather.fjordClosed: Strong winds have roughened the sea. Fjord departures pause today; the return crossing from the landing remains open.
weather.sledClosed: A whiteout has hidden the dog-team markers. The trip is postponed; your gear and quest progress are unchanged, and marked footpaths remain open.
journal.keys: Enter: claim this reward  |  Esc: back to list / close
weekly.locked: Weekly contracts open after the shed repair. Offers refresh on Monday; the team may accept one per week, due Sunday.
weekly.keys: Left/Right: choose | Enter: accept | Esc: close. One team contract each week, due Sunday.
weekly.crate.empty: This is the community fish crate. Accept the guesthouse fish contract on the noticeboard first.
weekly.crate.keys: Arrows: backpack slot   Enter: donate   Esc: confirm and close; donated fish are consumed.
ice.season: This surveyed ice-fishing station opens in winter. Stay on the timber platform.
ice.locked: The fjord boat must be repaired before the ice station can open.
ice.ready: The opening is clear for today. From the end of the timber platform, cast a short distance east into the dark opening. Polar cod; halibut requires fishing level 4. Sea ice is never a footpath.
ice.host: Ask the host to check and clear the opening. Everyone can fish here once it is open.
ice.tool: Hold your pickaxe and interact with this marker to clear the surveyed opening. Repeat the inspection each winter day. Keep both feet on the timber platform.
ice.opened: The surveyed opening is ready. Cast east from the platform; do not step onto sea ice.
sled.season: The dog-team route opens in winter. Marked walking trails remain open in other seasons.
sled.single: Dog-team travel is currently available in single-player. Please use the marked walking trail in multiplayer.
sled.locked: Mira: Help the harbor repair the processing shed first; then we can prepare the winter route together.
sled.tools: Mira: My lashing tool was left beside the parked sled on the mountain trail. Check the station marker there, then bring it to the tundra stop.
sled.toolFound: You found the lashing tool. Return it at the tundra stop.
sled.toolsDone: The equipment yard is in order. Use the tundra, camp or glacier stop to arrange a journey.
sled.supplies: Mira: Thank you. Collect the packed supplies at the field-camp sign and bring them back to the tundra stop.
sled.supplyFound: The packed supplies are in your bag. Bring them to the tundra stop.
sled.repair: Mira: The last job is the stop repair. Bring 20 wood and 5 fiber to the tundra stop for the rail and lashings.
sled.repairConfirm: Use 20 wood and 5 fiber to repair the tundra stop?
sled.trial: Mira: Everything is checked. Take the first route from the tundra stop to the field camp; then all three winter stops will open.
sled.choose: Mira: The team is ready. Where shall we go?
sled.full: Please leave one empty bag slot for the equipment.
sled.unavailable: The route is not ready. You can still return by the marked walking trail.
sled.unlocked: First journey completed. All three winter dog-team stops are open.
sled.item.0.name: Lashing tool
sled.item.0.desc: Mira left it beside the parked sled. Return it at the tundra stop.
sled.item.1.name: Packed trail supplies
sled.item.1.desc: Packed at the field camp. Deliver it to the tundra stop.
guide.goal.boatWait: The iron is delivered. Roan is fitting the boat tonight. Sleep, then use the eastern pier route sign tomorrow. You can claim any pending reward now.
guide.goal.shedWait: The wood is delivered. Roan will finish the shed overnight. Sleep, then check the harbor and the guesthouse writing desk tomorrow. Pending rewards can be claimed now.
guide.goal.ironProgress: Iron bars in your pack: {{count}} / 2. Give Roan both in one stack; the boat opens the next morning.
guide.goal.ironTrade: Harbor supplies: 3 {{fish}} for a bar. In your pack: {{count}} / 3; trades left: {{trades}}. Mined bars or imports (1000g each) also work.
guide.goal.ironSource: Local fish trades are used up. Mine iron at home or buy bars at harbor supplies (1000g each).
shelter.title: Snow blocks, Arctic light
shelter.subtitle: Mira's camp model / winter shelter study
shelter.season: The snow-block model opens in winter. These summer canvas tents are modern field shelters. The red research hut offers overnight accommodation.
shelter.instruction: Move the highlighted snow course sideways. Place its joints between those below, then confirm each of the three courses.
shelter.context: Snow houses use suitable compacted snow, not ice bricks. Their blocks rise in a spiral and lean inward. This flat model shows only seam spacing; it is not a full building method. Snow houses are not universal Arctic homes.
shelter.retry: These joints line up with the course below. Shift the highlighted blocks by half a block and try again.
shelter.progress: Courses placed: {{count}} / 3. Leaving early does not record completion.
shelter.complete: The model is complete. You have recorded the camp snow-block exercise. You may repeat it another time.
shelter.save: Sleep to save your personal record. The research hut has a bed. No materials were spent; replays award no items or money.
shelter.keys: Left / Right or A / D: shift   Enter / Space: place   Esc: leave   Controller: D-pad / A / B
shelter.subtitleDone: Mira's camp model / recorded — you may practise again
daily.quality: The guesthouse needs 2 silver-or-better seasonal fish. Normal-quality fish stay in your backpack.
daily.reopen: This daily delivery has already been made, or the date has changed. Please reopen the counter.
guide.wildlife.help: Stand within the marked viewing distance during the listed season and hours. Press R to make a dated observation in this save.
guide.wildlife.tooFar: This animal is outside the marked viewing distance, or not present at this time.
guide.wildlife.already: This sighting is already in your field notes.
guide.wildlife.safety: A polar bear is visible beyond the glacier lookout. Stay on the marked deck; dog-team departures to the glacier pause today. The walking trail remains open.
guide.wildlife.bear.name: Polar bear
guide.wildlife.bear.where: Glacier lookout · winter daylight, on selected days.
guide.wildlife.bear.body: A distant sighting on the ice front. Keep to the marked observation deck and give the animal space. Fresh tracks lead across the snow; no approach or feeding is possible.
guide.wildlife.fox.name: Arctic fox
guide.wildlife.fox.body: A small fox moves between low tundra cover and exposed rock. Its coat shifts from pale winter tones to darker summer colour.
guide.wildlife.caribou.name: Greenland caribou
guide.wildlife.caribou.where: Tundra · spring through autumn, daytime on selected days.
guide.wildlife.caribou.body: A distant herd pauses on open ground. Watch from the path; the animals are not approached, fed, ridden, or harvested.
guide.wildlife.seal.name: Ringed seal
guide.wildlife.seal.where: Icefjord margin · spring, autumn, or winter daylight.
guide.wildlife.seal.body: A seal rests near the water and returns to the sea. Observe from the safe shore platform; this is a sighting, not a catch.
guide.wildlife.walrus.name: Walrus
guide.wildlife.walrus.where: Harbor outer water · summer or autumn, on selected days.
guide.wildlife.walrus.body: The tusked marine mammal appears offshore. Keep clear of the water edge and watch from the pier.
guide.wildlife.owl.name: Snowy owl
guide.wildlife.owl.where: Northern tundra lookout · autumn or winter, daylight on selected days.
guide.wildlife.owl.body: A pale owl rests against the open tundra. The lookout is a quiet viewing place; leave the bird undisturbed.
guide.wildlife.kittiwake.name: Black-legged kittiwake
guide.wildlife.kittiwake.where: Harbor outer pier · spring through autumn, 06:00–20:00.
guide.wildlife.kittiwake.body: A small gull circles the working waterfront and rests above the tide line. Its call belongs to the coast, not to the inland tundra.
guide.wildlife.sleddog.name: Working sled dogs
guide.wildlife.sleddog.where: Sled trail yard · winter, after the shed repair.
guide.wildlife.sleddog.body: The dogs rest in their work yard between trips. No hunger, death, or punishment system is used; their role is transport and companionship.
guide.wildlife.whale.name: Humpback whale
guide.wildlife.whale.where: Icefjord lookout · summer afternoon, on selected days.
guide.wildlife.whale.body: A distant back and brief blow rise beyond the floating ice. The whale remains offshore and cannot be fished or sold.
guide.wildlife.shark.name: Greenland shark
guide.wildlife.shark.where: Icefjord deep water · autumn or winter, on selected days.
guide.wildlife.shark.body: A dim silhouette passes well below the surface. It is a research observation only; the shark is not a fishable or sellable item.
sled.wildlifeClosed: Mira: A polar bear is visible near the glacier today. Dog-team trips to that stop are paused until tomorrow; the marked walking trail remains open.
guide.phenomena.help: Visit the safe lookout when the light or weather matches the note, then press R. The entry records this date only.
guide.phenomena.tooFar: The selected sky or weather event is not visible from this place at this time.
guide.phenomena.midnightSun.name: Midnight sun
guide.phenomena.midnightSun.where: Tundra or glacier lookout · early summer, late evening.
guide.phenomena.midnightSun.body: In the long-light season, the horizon keeps a pale glow late into the game night. The clock and bedtime remain unchanged.
guide.phenomena.polarNight.name: Polar-night twilight
guide.phenomena.polarNight.body: The winter noon is a short blue twilight, not full daylight. Lamps add warmth while the normal game clock continues.
guide.phenomena.aurora.name: Aurora over the fjord
guide.phenomena.aurora.where: Icefjord, glacier lookout or Winter 21 lantern walk · clear winter nights after 18:00.
guide.phenomena.aurora.body: A restrained green aurora passes above the distant ice. It is a visual observation only; it gives no magic bonus and changes no weather.
guide.phenomena.blizzard.name: Whiteout on the tundra
guide.phenomena.blizzard.where: Northern tundra lookout · during a forecast blizzard.
guide.phenomena.blizzard.body: Wind-driven snow crosses the marked route. Fjord and dog-team departures pause, while return and walking routes remain available.
guide.research.progress.fish: Recorded fish or submitted fish samples: {{count}} / {{total}}
guide.research.title: Field research ledger
guide.research.rewardReady: Complete fieldwork has earned a letter with a placeable field-atlas display.
guide.research.rewardLocked: Record all nine seafood species, eight animal classes, four sky signs and four landforms; submit three distinct fish samples to Levin. The reward arrives by mail.
guide.secret.help: Reach the place when its season, time and conditions match, then press R to record the discovery.
guide.secret.tooFar: The clue is not ready or you are not close enough to it yet.
guide.secret.foxTracks.name: Arctic fox tracks
guide.secret.foxTracks.clue: After a fresh winter squall, look for small tracks at the northern tundra path at dawn.
guide.secret.foxTracks.body: Four small prints cross the new snow and lead toward the fox's distant route.
guide.secret.icebergLookout.name: The quiet lookout
guide.secret.icebergLookout.clue: A less-traveled shore path on the west side of the fjord reaches a bench above the ice.
guide.secret.icebergLookout.body: The hidden bench gives a still view across the icebergs, far from the working pier.
guide.secret.midnightSun.name: Midnight sun
guide.secret.midnightSun.clue: On a late summer night, take the high tundra path while the horizon is still bright.
guide.secret.midnightSun.body: The low sun remains at the horizon. This is a field note, not a change to the clock.
guide.secret.snowyOwl.name: Snowy owl
guide.secret.snowyOwl.clue: A pale shape returns to the northern ridge on some autumn and winter mornings.
guide.secret.snowyOwl.body: The owl lifts from the rocks after a respectful, distant observation.
guide.secret.whaleShadow.name: A whale beyond the ice
guide.secret.whaleShadow.clue: On selected summer afternoons, wait at the fjord water beyond the floating ice.
guide.secret.whaleShadow.body: A back and brief blow appear offshore, then vanish behind the ice. The sighting is never a catch.
guide.secret.polarNightLights.name: Lights in the long night
guide.secret.polarNightLights.clue: Visit the town lamps after dark during winter's short blue day.
guide.secret.polarNightLights.body: Warm windows and harbor lamps hold their colour against the winter twilight.
guide.secret.oldShipLog.name: Roan's old ship log
guide.secret.oldShipLog.clue: Find Roan at the harbor once your friendship has grown; ask about the old crossing.
guide.secret.oldShipLog.body: Roan shares a page from his grandfather's route book. The miniature boat is a keepsake, not a travel unlock.
festival.spring.quiz: Guess the weight of today's cod
festival.spring.castStart: Cast from the public pier. Return here and press F after landing a fish.
festival.spring.noCatch: The challenge is still waiting for a landed fish. Your bait and time remain yours.
festival.spring.quizPrompt: The cod on the scale weighs 2.1 kg. Which range is closest?
festival.spring.quizWrong: Not quite. The crew records the estimate; the next cast is still yours.
festival.spring.quizRight: A close estimate. The harbor crew awards this year's keepsake.
festival.spring.mealNoMoney: The stew costs 100g. Nothing was taken.
festival.spring.mealBought: A hot harbor meal for the walk along the pier.
festival.summer.quiz: Nature quiz: what keeps nesting birds safe?
festival.summer.quizWrong: The note is added to the field guide. Keep the nesting ledges quiet.
festival.summer.quizRight: Correct: stay on shore and keep a respectful distance. You receive this year's display.
festival.winter.soup: Share a bowl of hot fish soup — 100g
festival.winter.view: Take the lantern walk and watch the north
festival.winter.mealNoMoney: The soup costs 100g. Nothing was taken.
festival.winter.soupBought: You share a warm supper with the harbor crew. The town remembers it.
festival.winter.viewTaken: The lanterns stay low. The northern sky remains open if the clouds clear.
festival.already: You have already received this year's festival keepsake.
festival.notFestival: These activities are available during the local festival only.
festival.answer.boat: From a boat beside the colony
festival.answer.shore: From shore, at a respectful distance
